numericIdHighWaterMark.description: Nonnegative int64 decimal string, at most 9223372036854775807.

water.description: Bounded native water. Present, even empty, means a dry world wherever no body covers. Requires resolver 2.

waterRect.description: Lattice cell bounds, minimum included and maximum excluded.

signedInt64Decimal.description: Canonical int64 decimal string, preserving exact signed patch slots.

positiveInt64Decimal.description: Canonical ASCII decimal string from 1 to 9223372036854775807 with no sign or leading zero. Each alternative bounds one prefix of the int64 maximum, and the final lookahead refuses a trailing newline that a bare end anchor would allow.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest, exactly 64 ASCII characters, as closure loading requires.

numericId.description: Positive int64 decimal string, at most 9223372036854775807.
